name: firecrawl
description: Firecrawl MCP tools for Codex: search the web, read pages and documents, crawl and map sites, research developer sources and papers, and run structured research jobs.

interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the hosted Firecrawl MCP server with your Firecrawl account. Sign in once with OAuth; no API key is needed. Firecrawl tools are listed to the model directly rather than behind tool search.
